Package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.tool

package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.domain.tool
Tool bounded context — domain layer.

Carries ToolDescriptor and the per-context business exceptions (e.g. UnknownToolException). Populated by EPIC-07.
